summary: Frontend E2E (Pro, desktop 1920 + mobile 390) on a temporary TEST_ui82 boat. I re-ran the backend test test_zone_colours.py: 7/7 pass. Working: zone map rows (name box, colour square left of Edit labels, coloured left border); colour picker (20 swatches, the other map's colour disabled, picking Teal updates square, border, group header and toast, and it persists after reload with colour_manual=true); naming 'Saloon port side' auto-colours a Gold map Green with toast 'Zone map named Saloon port side and coloured Green'; a manually chosen colour is not overridden when renamed 'Cockpit area'; a 3rd map uploaded through the UI got the first free colour (Gold); pinning through ZonePinEditor puts the area in the right colour group; rainbow grouping (Green, then Teal, then 'Not on a zone map') with map-name headers; F toggle lights up, inventory-area-food-badge does not exist, and names line up (x=738 for all). Sub-areas: add 'Blue box' gives a CLOSED nested card (data-sub=true) and parent count '1 item · 1 folder or box'; a duplicate name (any case) is rejected with an inline error; an item added inside a sub-area persists; take-out works; merging Red folder into Saloon nav desk cupboard works (confirm button disabled until a parent is picked, the area itself is not offered); merging into a parent that already has a sub with that name is rejected; taking out a sub whose name clashes with a top-level area is rejected. Search 'impeller' shows the parent and the sub; the sub path reads 'Cockpit area › Saloon nav desk cupboard' and the parent path reads 'Cockpit area'; searching the parent name shows all of its subs. Deleting a parent with 2 subs removes all of them and Undo restores all of them. Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow and the name box is full width. All changes were checked in MongoDB after the 700ms sync.

ui_bugs.issue: The colour 'square' shows as a narrow 12x20px pill and the button is 36x48, not 36x36. Root cause: App.css .btn-ghost sets padding: 0 10px and min-height: 48px, which override Tailwind p-0 and h-9 because App.css loads later. Fix: use !p-0 !min-h-0 on the trigger, or a plain button class, and add shrink-0 to the inner span.

issues: The colour square, Edit labels and Remove this map do not fit on one row below the name box (36+132+154+gaps is more than the 318px available). Remove this map wraps onto a 3rd right-aligned line. Shrinking the Remove label to 'Remove', or fixing the btn-ghost min-height/padding, would keep it on one row.
The name input is only about 158px wide, so the placeholder 'Name this map, e.g. Saloon' is cut off to 'Name this map, e.'

Coloured cards have a 6px left border and uncoloured ones 1.5px, so names in the 'Not on a zone map' group sit about 4px left of names in coloured groups. Consider a transparent 6px left border on uncoloured cards.

action_items: Fix the MapColourPicker trigger sizing so it is a real rounded square (override .btn-ghost padding and min-height).
Mobile zone map row: keep colour square + Edit labels + Remove on one row under the name box.
Optional: widen the desktop name input or shorten its placeholder; even out left-border width for uncoloured inventory cards.
critical_code_review_comments: ZonePinEditor area select lists sub-areas by their bare name (e.g. 'Blue box', with no 'Parent ›' prefix), so a folder can be pinned and look like a top-level area. Consider listing only top-level areas, or using the labelled names.
Same root cause as the picker: any 'btn-ghost h-9' button (Edit labels, Remove this map) is 48px tall, not 36px.

Sync is debounced by 700ms (useBoatStore). Edits made just before closing the tab are lost unless there is a flush on pagehide/visibilitychange. Seen in testing when the browser closed within 700ms of an edit (food toggle, sub item, take-out). A real user closing the app quickly would hit the same thing.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows work; 1 medium sizing bug + layout nits)
